name: matt-skills-curated
description: Curated engineering and productivity Skills adapted from Matt Pocock's MIT-licensed agent skills for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: A curated ChatGPT and Codex distribution of Matt Pocock's MIT-licensed engineering and productivity workflows. It routes ambiguous work to focused Skills for requirements discovery, specs, tickets, TDD, debugging, code review, architecture, research, triage, handoffs, teaching, and agent-facing documentation. Beta, deprecated, Claude-only marketplace, npm release, and repository-development material are excluded from the public package.
defaultPrompt: Choose the best engineering workflow for this task and execute it
Turn this idea into a buildable engineering plan
Diagnose this bug, fix it, and verify the result
